description: This file defines the DCountA class, a calculation function for counting nonblank cells in a database column that match specified criteria, as part of a PHP spreadsheet library.

classes.name: DCountA
classes.description: A class implementing the DCOUNTA Excel function, counting nonempty cells in a database column matching criteria.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the DCountA function with provided database, field, and criteria, returning the count or error.
